title: Introduction to Art Education II
description: A continuing investigation of studio processes and art concepts as well as methods of instruction appropriate to children and youths in classroom and community settings.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of AE 103B, AE 103, AE 100, AE 101, AE 204, ED-A 701, EDCI 307, EDCI 307A, EDCI 307B, EDUC 307.
Students planning to emphasize art in their degree program should register in this course.
